title: docs: hand-written inventory counts are deleted across skills, docs, READMEs and code comments; the names and the source of truth stay
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi6Px7HCkNBYctmRf2kDX4bR)_

domain:skills#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2fNkBkNQ88EMzvcrPW

Fixes #27522

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 删掉手写的清单计数（「49 field types」「8 lifecycle events」「20 built-in node types」「Plugins (18)」「30 functions」「36 built-in tokens」「26 built-in metadata types」「10 built-in locales」「38 chart types」等）：卡片清单表 16 行全部处理，再加本次扩扫到的 docs、examples、ui README、代码注释里的同类计数；枚举出来的名字保留，`packages/metadata/README.md` 那张已经过时的类型表（列着 `trigger`、`validation`、`theme` 等根本不存在的类型）换成指向 `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` 的一句话。
- **为什么改：** 这些数字没有门禁对着目录核对，清单一动就错（showcase 写 38 种图表，spec 只有 20；README 写 26 种元数据类型，spec 有 31），错的数字比没有数字更误导读者和 AI 作者。
- **风险与回滚：** 纯文档、README、changeset 与两处代码注释（`packages/spec` 一行 `//` 注释，`ui/` 三个文件的注释），不改任何行为；回滚即还原本 PR。`skills/**` 为 Tier H。
- **先看：** `packages/metadata/README.md`（唯一删掉一张表的地方）、`skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md`（「Why so few?」那条说明）、`content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx` 首句。
- **两分钟验证：** `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期最后一行 `✓ check-skills-token-ratchet: 84 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings`。
- **需要你做的：** `skills/**` 是 Tier H，落地需 os-zhuang 或 hotlong 批准；其余由席位落地。

## What changes

Rule applied, from the triage ruling: delete the number, or point at the source of truth; a count that matters is generated or pinned by an existing gate; no new gate.

### The card's Inventory table, every row taken

| File | Was | Now |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` L41, L297 | 49 field types | the names stay; the table in `rules/field-types.md` is the pointer |
| `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` L9 | 49 available options | the available options |
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` L46 | the 8 lifecycle events | the lifecycle events |
| `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` L10, L31, L46 | 8 lifecycle events; "Why only 8?" | lifecycle events; "Why so few?" (the explanation of why `find` is the only read event stays) |
| `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` L54 | 20 built-in node types | built-in node types (the node tables follow) |
| `skills/objectui/README.md` L58 | Plugins (18) | Plugins (the names follow) |
| `skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md` L231 | 30 functions | "the whole registry" (the function table above it is the enumeration) |
| `content/docs/capabilities/views.mdx` L30 | 36 built-in tokens | built-in tokens |
| `content/docs/releases/implementation-status.mdx` L45 | 14 lifecycle events | the lifecycle events that actually fire (a living status page per triage, not a release note) |
| `docs/qa/platform-checklist/README.md` L374 | 49 field types, 20 chart types | field types, chart types (the gate-pinned `enumSource.expect` is untouched) |
| `examples/app-showcase/README.md` L19, L72 | all 49 field types, all 8 view types, all 38 chart types | every field type, every view type, every chart type |
| `packages/metadata/README.md` L195 | 26 built-in metadata types across 6 protocol domains, plus a table | a pointer at `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` and `MetadataTypeSchema` (see Acceptance notes: the table was wrong, not just stale) |
| `packages/metadata/ROADMAP.md` L23 | 26 built-in metadata types across 6 domains | the built-in metadata types of `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY`, by protocol domain |
| `packages/spec/PLUGIN_STANDARDS.md` L208 | 17 services across 13 plugins | services registered by plugins via `ctx.registerService()` |
| `ui/packages/i18n/README.md` L3, L7 | 10 built-in locales | built-in locales (L7 still lists them) |

### The wider re-sweep (sites the card did not list)

Patterns: a digit, a `N+`, a parenthesised `(N)` or a spelled-out number before an inventory noun, over `skills/**`, `content/docs/**`, `docs/qa/**`, `examples/**`, package READMEs, `ui/**` READMEs, and `.describe()` / JSDoc / code comments in `packages/spec/src` and `ui/packages/*/src`.

- `skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md` L238: "The six functions (…)" → "The functions (…)".
- `skills/objectui/guides/plugin-development.md` L95: "The eleven control kinds" → "The control kinds" (a code comment inside the guide).
- `content/docs/capabilities/index.mdx`: "40+ field types", "Nine lenses", "Five trigger styles", "Seven approver styles, four decision modes"; `data.mdx` L4 "40+ field types"; `approvals.mdx` L4, L10, L26 (two headings: "seven resolution styles", "four decision modes"; no page linked those anchors, `check:doc-anchors` green); `automation.mdx` L4 "Five trigger styles"; `analytics.mdx` L4, L12, L29 "~20 / roughly twenty chart families", "four report shapes".
- `content/docs/frontend/plugins/index.mdx` L24 "14+ official plugins" (18 exist); `frontend/architecture-overview.mdx` L317–L330 "20+ hooks", "91+ Shadcn UI atoms", "35+ field renderers", "20 plugin packages", "(15 more)".
- `content/docs/protocol/objectql/index.mdx` L114 and `schema.mdx` L1036 "20+ field types"; `query-syntax.mdx` L350, L1217 "all five drivers", L1041 "All six functions".
- `content/docs/plugins/packages.mdx` L7 "72 package manifests", L27 "all 15 protocol domains"; `protocol/kernel/config-resolution.mdx` L149 "19 types"; `api/error-catalog.mdx` L7 "9 error categories and 56 error codes" (the page itself is the catalogue; no gate pins either number).
- `examples/app-todo/README.md` L51 "20+ fields", L66 "Actions (8)", L73 "4 Key Metrics", L77 "Reports (5)", L84 "Automation Flows (4)"; `examples/app-showcase/README.md` L159 "six protocol domains".
- `ui/packages/components/README.md` L9 "60+ Components (46 from Shadcn + 14 custom)"; `ui/apps/console/README.md` L11 "15+ view plugins"; `ui/packages/types/README.md` L409 "50+ members"; `ui/packages/plugin-grid/README.md` L101 "20 values and 29 types"; `ui/packages/plugin-form/README.md` L968 "all five renderers"; `ui/packages/fields/README.md` L344, L354 "All four widgets", "all eight read sites across the four widgets"; `ui/packages/i18n/README.md` L359 "three functions".
- Code comments: `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts` L82 "`hook` (24 lifecycle events)" (`HookEvent` declares eight); `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` L6, L735 and `registry.ts` L7 "27 metadata types" (`MetadataTypeSchema` declares 31); `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/zh.ts` L3190 "the other 21 node types". Comments only; no string a user sees carried a count.

### Kept, by name

- `content/docs/api/plugin-endpoints.mdx` L129 "all 12 routes": pinned by the cloud repo's `ai-route-ledger.ts` conformance test the sentence cites.
- `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx` L916 and `packages/client/CLIENT_SPEC_COMPLIANCE.md` L10 "27 routes": a dated audit measurement.
- `content/docs/ui/create-vs-edit-form.mdx` L92 "all 40 fields", `protocol/kernel/index.mdx` L164 "200+ plugins" and L233 "15 languages": hypotheticals, not inventories.
- `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-editor.mdx` L73 and `plugins/index.mdx` L169 "100+ languages": Monaco's inventory, not ours.
- `examples/README.md` L14, `examples/app-crm/README.md` L5 and `getting-started/examples.mdx` L240–L244 ("10+ objects", "15+ actions per domain", "5 AI agents"): HotCRM, an external repository.
- `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` L242–L244 ("2-3 locales", "5-20 objects"): sizing thresholds, not counts.
- `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/number-format.ts` L273 "10 locales x 18 values x 4 precisions": a recorded measurement.
- Counts of two or three that structure the paragraph enumerating them ("three run modes", "Three view kinds", "Three action types", "two channels") in `skills/**`: left as written.
- Everything on the card's own out-of-scope list: release notes and CHANGELOGs, `docs/audits/**`, `ui/docs/**` (ADRs, audits, design, RFCs), `packages/spec/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md`, `packages/core/PHASE2_IMPLEMENTATION.md`, `packages/spec/liveness/README.md`, `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`, sample CLI output, the computed "10 skills" and generated "106 components", `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` L87.

### Skills readings (Tier H, `skills/**`)

Deletion only. Lines are unchanged in every touched file (no re-wrap); tokens are `ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)` on the whole file, stamp line included.

| File | Lines before → after | Tokens before → after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` | 472 → 472 | 6111 → 6106 |
| `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` | 320 → 320 | 3151 → 3151 (one word swapped, equal bytes; ceiling 3158, PR #27475's seven-token headroom there is intact) |
| `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` | 973 → 973 | 10066 → 10064 |
| `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` | 452 → 452 | 6454 → 6453 |
| `skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md` | 403 → 403 | 4173 → 4172 |
| `skills/objectui/README.md` | 64 → 64 | 729 → 728 |
| `skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md` | 642 → 642 | 6571 → 6565 |
| `skills/objectui/guides/plugin-development.md` | 482 → 482 | 4184 → 4183 |

Whole package: the sum of every `SKILL.md` is 4610 → 4610 lines; the ratcheted authored bundle is 207857 → 207840 tokens (the gate's own figure after: `ratcheted (authored) 207840 / 217474`).

`@objectstack/skills` patch changeset: `.changeset/27522-inventory-counts.md`.

## Tests

None added or changed: the diff is prose, READMEs, one changeset and four code comments. No behaviour is tested by a count.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/metadata/README.md`'s table was not merely stale. It listed `validation`, `theme`, `workflow`, `trigger`, `schedule`, `manifest`, `permission_set`, `role`, `profile`, `rag_pipeline`, `model` and `prompt`, none of which is in `MetadataTypeSchema` (31 names on `main`), and the spec's own comment says there is no `trigger` and no `validation` metadata type. Keeping those names would have taught the wrong thing, so the rule's second arm applies: the section now points at the registry and keeps no copy.
- Serial constraint with PR #27475 (edits `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` L181): this PR edits L9 only; the branch is on today's `main` tip (`aef631b8`, which is an ancestor of this head), so there was nothing to merge.
- Out of scope, noted and not filed (carrier: none): `ui/packages/plugin-grid/README.md` keeps a hand-written export list under "The complete public surface"; nothing reads it against `src/index.ts`. Same class as this card, a different remedy (generate or delete the list), and not a count.
- Cross-lane per triage 6495060086: one PR carries the skills, devx, server, spec, ui and example halves; the claim declares the other lanes' files; the extra sites above are named here as the seat asked.

## Verification

Local gates, run at `93c9b71f`, every exit code captured before any pipe:

- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` → exit 0 (`✓ check-skills-token-ratchet: 84 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings; 10 generator-owned file(s) measured, not ratcheted.`), plus `--self-test` → 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && check:generated` → `✓ All 14 generated artifacts are up to date` (check:docs, check:skill-docs, check:skill-refs, check:api-surface, check:authorable-surface, check:export-origins, check:liveness, check:strictness-ledger, check:meta-url-spelling all ✓); `check:llms-txt` → 0.
- `pnpm check:doc-anchors`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:doc-frontmatter`, `check:docs-audit-scope`, `check:docs-single-h1`, `check:docs-spec-enumerations`, `check:docs-redirects`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:release-notes`, `check:release-page-status`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, `check:published-readme-links`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:org-identifier`, `check:keyed-text-bounds`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, `check:role-word`, `check:pm-prior-rulings`, `check:platform-checklist`, `check:examples-live-imports`, `check:spec-docblock-symbol-anchors`, `check:overlay-whitelist-table`, `check:system-context-census`, and the `node scripts/check-*.mjs` docs families the derivation named → all exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED locally, prerequisite not met (exit 3), left to CI: `check:i18n` (needs the built CLI), `check:docs-transcript-drift` (needs `@objectstack/lint` built), `check:skill-examples` (needs `packages/client-react/dist`); `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check` and `@object-ui/app-shell type-check` stop on the unbuilt `ui/packages/core` and `@object-ui/fields` closure (the diff in those packages is comments only); every other family in `dispatch-gates --commands` (repo-wide scans such as `pnpm lint`, the `ui/` test and build lanes, Test Core) is CI's run and is cited from this PR's check-runs.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` over the recorded subset: see the os-dev-report comment on the card for the reconciliation line.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (one `//` comment changed)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no names added)

- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: `check:generated` reports all 14 artifacts current; nothing to regenerate for a comment.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/` or `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md`; `content/docs/releases/implementation-status.mdx` is the one releases-tree file, a living status page the card and triage put in scope, in a docs-only PR.
